description.fallback: Sometime between the 12th and 16th century, an ancient Aztec ritual takes place in Mexico, where a man wearing a Stone Mask sacrifices a young woman, stabbing her through the chest. Her blood splatters onto the mask, and bone-like prongs sprout from it piercing the man's head. Despite this, he remains alive, and screams to his audience that he has gained eternal life.

text.fallback: Head out: Dio Brando the Invader, Part 1

outro.fallback: His nose bloodied, the boy pulls out a handkerchief with his name embroidered on it: Jonathan Joestar.
The bullies, spiteful of the privilege he has as a rich person, beat Jonathan up further.
